title: Run a single TS integration test file with --runTestsByPath
answers: how to run only tracing tests for a TypeScript integration
run one jest test file in libs/typescript/integrations
npm test single file integration claude-code codex qwen-code
how to run opencode index test alone
body:
Run one test file in an integration package with: npm run -C libs/typescript/integrations/<pkg> test -- --runTestsByPath tests/<file>.test.ts
The PR used this for claude-code (tests/tracing.test.ts), codex and qwen-code (tests/tracing.test.ts), and opencode (tests/index.test.ts). The path after --runTestsByPath is relative to the package directory, and the -- separator forwards the flag to the test runner.
For the shared resolver, run libs/typescript/core with tests/core/utils/index.test.ts the same way.
For the Python side, the PR ran uv run --with claude-agent-sdk pytest tests/claude_code/test_tracing.py.
applies: Local iteration on individual test files in the TypeScript integration packages.
says: Run automated test verification for a single coding assistant integration in isolation
Test execution runs the full integration suite instead of checking one specific assistant
Check tracing behavior on an individual agent integration without running all integration tests
Speed up verification by running tests for only one coding tool integration

The same pattern runs shared resolver tests in libs/typescript/core using tests/core/utils/index.test.ts across integration packages such as claude-code, codex, qwen-code, and opencode. Python tracing tests are run using uv run --with claude-agent-sdk pytest tests/claude_code/test_tracing.py.
